turns.text: Hey Sofia! How is your Wednesday going at the clinic? How are you holding up with the Tucson heat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Oh, it is absolutely scorching today. I had to start my morning early with just a simple mug of regular brewed coffee from the pot before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a classic start to the day. Did you skip using your roommate's fancy espresso machine today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I did. I was a bit rushed, so I just grabbed the quick coffee and got behind the wheel. I drove my hybrid to work today to make sure I got to the clinic on time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: With this heat, having the A/C in your own car is definitely the way to go. How is the day treating you so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It has been pretty busy, but I managed to have a nice lunch break. I brought a sandwich I made using some slices of my home-baked wild yeast loaf.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! Your baking skills must be coming in handy. Have you and Tom had any time to think about the wedding plans for summer 2028?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks, the bread turned out great! And yes, Tom and I actually spent last night looking at some possible venues online. It still feels far away, but we want to get a head start.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's very smart, summer 2028 will be here before you know it. How is the online Italian course going? Are you still finding time for that?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's going well! I did a couple of modules on Monday evening. I'm trying to keep up with it.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great progress. Is Tom trying to learn any Italian with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He tries to help me practice, but his pronunciation is so funny we usually just end up laughing the whole time.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a fun way to study at least! Do you have any plans for the rest of your evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just heading home to relax and maybe watch a movie with Tom. Talk to you tomorrow!
